name: @atomize-hq/ds-skills
description: Portable design-system skills, evidence-grounded library curation, and token/Figma workflows for independently installed project consumers.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prebuild-plugin.mjs && node scripts/prebuild-token-compiler.mjs && node scripts/prebuild-project-host.mjs && node scripts/prebuild-storybook.mjs && node scripts/prebuild-chromatic.mjs && node scripts/prebuild-foundations.mjs && node scripts/stamp-release.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm loc && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm smoke && pnpm pack-check
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.flattenTokenDocument!=='function'||typeof m.buildExpectedVariables!=='function')throw new Error('built package does not expose its API');console.log('smoke ok')})"
scripts.loc: tokei --files --output json src plugin bin scripts installers .github/actions | node scripts/validate-loc.mjs 300
